name: Weighted Decision Matrix
description: Builds and populates a weighted decision matrix for a specific choice. Identifies criteria from user priorities, assigns weights, scores each option, and computes weighted totals with a clear recommendation. Use when the user asks about making a decision between multiple options, building a decision matrix, comparing options with weighted criteria, or applying a structured scoring framework to a choice. Do NOT use for business strategic decisions or resource allocation (use business strategy skills), simple two-option comparisons (use pro-con-analysis), or task prioritization (use task-prioritization).
